Backend Engineer, Platform — Ramp (New York)

You will build and own the services that move money. This is a backend role: you will write
Python and Go every day, design APIs other teams depend on, and be responsible for the
reliability of what you ship.

What you'll do
- Design and build REST APIs and event-driven services in Python and Go
- Own database schema design and query performance on PostgreSQL
- Build async processing pipelines with Redis and Kafka
- Instrument services with Prometheus and Grafana; own SLOs and on-call for your surface
- Containerize with Docker and deploy on Kubernetes through CI/CD
- Write unit and integration tests; participate in code review

What we look for
- Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, distributed systems
- Experience with FastAPI or similar; REST API design
- Comfort with observability, caching, and horizontal scaling
- Bonus: security-minded engineering, authentication and authorization systems
